initial.title: [v0.92.1][INT-01] Release-tail admission
initial.goal: Produce one immutable release-tail admission decision that includes a complete expected-versus-observed gap analysis for v0.92.1.
initial.required_outcome: Every planned issue and retained dependency is reconciled against merged ancestry, production implementation, validation, review, documentation, integration, and closeout evidence; unresolved P0/P1 or unowned material gaps block admission.
authority_boundary: #516 decides release-tail admission but does not approve the release
Canonical issue acceptance and execution specifications define the expected denominator
Merged code and retained evidence define observed truth
Missing evidence is a gap or ambiguity, never implicit success
Child remediation remains owned by the applicable issue
operator_constraints: Do not create duplicate remediation issues when an owner exists
Do not admit test-only, placeholder, unused, or do-nothing implementations
Do not mutate cloud or runtime infrastructure
Do not approve, merge, finish, or close the milestone
initial.task_boundary: Build one complete release-tail census and gap-analysis packet, then emit one fail-closed admission decision.
deliverables: Findings-first gap analysis in Markdown and JSON
Exact issue, PR, revision, ancestry, artifact, and owner denominator
Updated demo matrix only where observed evidence requires correction
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every planned v0.92.1 issue and retained predecessor dependency is enumerated with no silent omission
AC-2: Every required lane is reviewed, merged, ancestral, and indexed by exact revision and artifact
AC-3: Acceptance criteria and execution specifications are compared with real production implementation and execution evidence
AC-4: Test-only, placeholder, unused, partially wired, do-nothing, or unexecuted implementations are identified and cannot pass admission
AC-5: Missing validation, stale review, documentation drift, collision, and closeout overclaim findings carry severity, evidence, uncertainty, disposition, and owner
AC-6: Gap results are classified as release blockers, durable proof gaps, routed work, stale readiness documentation, or non-blocking quality concerns
AC-7: No unresolved P0/P1 gap or unowned material gap remains in an admitted candidate
AC-8: Machine-readable and human-readable gap reports and the admission record agree on denominator, revisions, findings, and decision
non_goals: Perform live cloud or runtime mutations
initial.plan_summary: Enumerate the complete expected baseline, collect exact observed evidence, run findings-first gap classification, route each material gap to an existing owner, and emit a fail-closed release-tail decision.

steps.action: Build the canonical issue, dependency, acceptance, and execution-specification denominator.
Collect exact merged ancestry, implementation call-path, validation, review, documentation, integration, and closeout evidence for every denominator row.
Generate findings-first Markdown and JSON gap reports with severity, evidence, uncertainty, disposition, classification, and owner.
Resolve denominator collisions and verify every material gap is fixed, explicitly release-blocking, or routed to an existing owner.
Emit and validate the immutable release-tail admission decision without approving the release.

invariants: Production-path proof rather than string presence
risks: Treating closed issues as proof of implemented behavior
Missing inherited or retained dependency scope
stop_conditions: The expected issue or acceptance denominator is incomplete
Any required lane lacks reviewed merged ancestry
A required behavior exists only as a stub, test fixture, unused path, or unsupported claim
Any unresolved P0/P1 or unowned material gap remains

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove every planned issue and retained dependency is represented exactly once with canonical acceptance authority.
Prove each acceptance row has production implementation, meaningful validation, current review, and truthful closeout evidence or an explicit finding.
Prove Markdown, JSON, ancestry, findings, owners, and the final fail-closed admission decision agree.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on an incomplete denominator, missing production-path proof, stale or contradictory evidence, unresolved collision, unresolved P0/P1 finding, unowned material gap, or disagreement between gap reports and admission decision.
review_prompts: Does the denominator include every planned issue, retained dependency, and acceptance row exactly once?
Does observed evidence prove production behavior rather than test-only or string-presence claims?
Are missing evidence and ambiguity reported rather than converted into success?
Does every material gap have a truthful classification and existing owner?
Would the admission decision fail closed for every unresolved P0/P1 gap?
initial.review_scope: The complete v0.92.1 expected-versus-observed denominator, implementation and execution gaps, evidence truth, ownership routing, and release-tail admission decision only.
